result.summary: The page is largely well-composed and consistent: header, search, filter chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom navigation all render correctly. Only two minor issues were found: inconsistent styling of the favorite (heart) buttons between restaurant cards, and low-contrast placeholder text in the search field. Clipped carousel/chip items and the bottom-cut card were treated as intended behavior and not reported.

issues.description: The favorite/heart button is styled inconsistently across the 'Popular right now' cards: on the Tokumaru Ramen Bar card the heart is a bare white outline with no background, while on the pizza card below it sits inside a dark circular scrim. This makes the same control look like two different components and reduces legibility of the first heart if the underlying image were lighter.
issues.suggestion: Apply the same circular semi-transparent dark background (scrim) to the heart button on every restaurant card so the control is visually consistent and always readable regardless of image content.

issues.description: The search field placeholder 'Restaurants, dishes, groceries' is light gray on a very light gray fill, giving a contrast ratio well below the 4.5:1 recommended for text, which can make it hard to read for low-vision users or in bright light.
issues.suggestion: Darken the placeholder text (e.g., to a mid-gray around #6B7280 or darker) or lighten/whiten the field background so the placeholder meets at least 4.5:1 contrast.
